findings.evidence: The Phase 1 database command runs this fixture. The fixture sets sourceCommit to forty `a` characters at line 39 and passes arbitrary source tree, artifact, sandbox-proof, deployment, and rollback hashes at lines 403-409. It creates no provider-backed RevenueCat sandbox proof rows. The exact deployed migration requires source commit fcf45ab8d450e4d51e0e2a18c7c2d195d055a2b6 at lines 80-89 and rejects an ineligible or mismatched sandbox proof at lines 281-291.
findings.impact: After the reconciled migration materializes, the first prepareReceipt("android") call is expected to fail before the intended 7/7 concurrency schedule, so the required Level C concurrency proof and Phase 1 database job are not current.
findings.requiredResolution: Keep the deployed migration byte-identical. In a bounded same-domain test-only correction, update the local fixture to construct the exact non-payable provider-backed sandbox proof and frozen source/artifact identities, preserve cleanup, then rerun the deterministic 7/7 command and the single frozen-head Phase 1 CI.

findings.evidence: The reconciliation report records read-only ledger hashes and one local reset at lines 9-32 and 72-97, but contains no `supabase db push --dry-run` result or explicit no-apply outcome.

findings.requiredResolution: Before merge, run the mandated dry-run once in an explicitly linked read-only context, retain the sanitized exact no-apply result, and bind it to this implementation head without deploying or rewriting the migration.

findings.evidence: The report marks T3_INTEGRATION and the focused pgTAP INTEGRATION_CLEAR at lines 54-58 and 83-93. Static review counted all 23 planned assertions but zero behavioral DML or throws/lives assertions; the identity, proof, and finalization checks primarily inspect pg_get_functiondef and constraint text, while the separate runtime concurrency fixture is incompatible with the new binding.
findings.impact: Catalog/source presence and local migration materialization do not prove that the source-identity, sandbox proof, grant, RLS, and finalization rejection paths execute correctly. This is a forbidden source-text-for-runtime proof substitution.
findings.requiredResolution: Do not claim T3 clear yet. Add deterministic database behavior cases for accepted exact input and rejected wrong source/artifact/proof/platform/final-run identity, test application-role denial through real role/RLS context, repair and run the concurrency fixture, then update the report from the new exact head.

findings.evidence: The report binds the frozen stopped PR #52 head but does not record PR #70, its implementation head/tree, exact base, changed-file hash, test-result hash, or current review head.
findings.impact: The parity facts are valid, but the reconciliation report alone cannot prove that its validation belongs to the exact reviewed PR #70 tree.

findings.resolution: Git uses exact deployed version 20260730142519 and name cognitive_livekit_final_chat_source_identity_binding. Source raw SHA-256 equals the coordinator-supplied read-only remote statement hash and the frozen PR #52 body byte-for-byte.

All four new SECURITY DEFINER functions use an empty search_path. Internal helpers deny PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, and service_role execution; the authenticated readback rechecks exact Owner identity; no service-role execution authority is added.

The exact deployed source changes no table grants or RLS policies and removes neither RLS nor FORCE RLS. The three evidence tables retain forced owner-scoped RLS and immutable update/delete triggers from their foundation migration.
